influence.en: Monday's closes: S&P 500 7549.94, Nasdaq 25253.139, Dow 52389.75, 10-year yield 4.8738%, 2-year yield 4.5594%, WTI 86.85, Brent 92.57, Shanghai 3660.79, October CPI 0.7% and PPI 5.7%.
Yicai (10 November). S&P 500 7549.94, Nasdaq 25253.14, Dow 52389.75, Nvidia down 4.27%, WTI 86.85, Brent 92.57, COMEX November gold 4105.00.
10 November 财经早茶. Equities jumped, the curve flattened, Brent touched the lowest since August, gold rebounded, and London copper rose. The chart is an estimate of October consumer prices.
influence.zh: 11月10日财经早茶。股市大涨，收益率曲线趋平，布伦特触及8月以来最低，黄金反弹，伦敦期铜走高。图是10月消费价格的估计。

influence.en: Caixin (10 November). The HFRI composite fell 1.36% in October. China's private stock-strategy index fell 11.35%, and the quant-long index fell 13.93%.
influence.zh: 财新（11月10日）。HFRI综合指数10月下跌1.36%。中国私募股票策略指数下跌11.35%，量化多头指数下跌13.93%。

influence.en: CICC (9 November). Optical modules, semiconductor manufacturing, and grid equipment still need earnings upgrades of 40% to 70% to match the current price. Cloud-company earnings have nearly 20% of room for a downward revision.
influence.zh: 中金（11月9日）。光模块、半导体制造、电网与配电仍需上修盈利40%至70%，才能匹配当前定价。云厂商盈利有近20%的下修空间。

influence.en: CICC (9 November). With crude off after the election, the producer pace can ease a little in November and December, and midstream demand still needs support.
influence.zh: 中金（11月9日）。选举之后原油回落，生产者价格同比在11月和12月或小幅放缓，中下游需求仍要政策托。

influence.en: BlockBeats (10 November). Anthropic plans to raise up to 69.3 billion dollars in an IPO.
influence.zh: 律动（11月10日）。Anthropic计划通过IPO最多募集693亿美元。

influence.en: BlockBeats (10 November). Richmond Fed president Barkin said rates still need to rise, and the pace should stay careful.
influence.zh: 律动（11月10日）。里士满联储行长巴尔金说利率仍需上升，步伐应当审慎。

influence.en: BlockBeats (10 November). MARA sold 13,597 bitcoin in October to repay loans.
influence.zh: 律动（11月10日）。MARA在10月出售13,597枚比特币，用于偿还贷款。

influence.en: BlockBeats (10 November), citing The Information. Nvidia's lobbying against export limits has lost influence since the scandal.
influence.zh: 律动（11月10日）引述The Information。丑闻之后，英伟达反对出口限制的游说影响力下降。

influence.en: Wallstreetcn (6 November). COMEX November gold settled Thursday at 4102.50 dollars.
influence.zh: 华尔街见闻（11月6日）。COMEX 11月黄金周四收于4102.50美元。

influence.en: Wallstreetcn (9 November). COMEX November gold settled Friday at 4064.5 dollars.
influence.zh: 华尔街见闻（11月9日）。COMEX 11月黄金周五收于4064.5美元。

influence.en: BLS calendar. October CPI is 10 November at 08:30 US Eastern, and October PPI is 13 November at that same time.
influence.zh: 美国劳工统计局日程。10月CPI在11月10日美东08:30，10月PPI在11月13日同一时间。

keySources.label: 第一财经 外汇存准

influence.en: Yicai (8 November). The FX reserve requirement rises 2 percentage points to 6% on 15 November.
influence.zh: 第一财经（11月8日）。11月15日起外汇存款准备金率上调2个百分点至6%。

title.en: The estimated monthly rise in US consumer prices is smaller
title.zh: 美国消费价格月度涨幅的估计低于前一个月

analysis.en: Orange bars are the monthly change in core consumer prices. The black line is the monthly change in overall consumer prices. The grey band on the right is an estimate for the last month on the axis, not a finished release. The last orange bar is still above the zero line and shorter than the bar before it, so the estimated monthly rise in core prices is smaller. The last black point is also above zero and lower than the point before it, so the estimated monthly rise in overall prices is smaller. These figures are approximate readings from the chart.
analysis.zh: 橙柱是核心消费价格的月度变化。黑线是总体消费价格的月度变化。右侧灰色带是坐标轴最后一个月份的估计，不是已经公布的结果。最后一根橙柱仍在零线上方，比前一根短，所以核心价格的月度涨幅估计更小。黑线末端也在零线上方，比前一个点更低，所以总体价格的月度涨幅估计更小。这些数字是从图上读出的约数。

marketTone.en: US stocks rose, and crude prices fell. Nvidia fell while the indexes rose. On the chart, the estimated monthly rise in US consumer prices is smaller than the month before.
marketTone.zh: 美股上涨，原油价格下跌。指数上涨，英伟达下跌。图上，美国消费价格月度涨幅的估计低于前一个月。

text.en: The S&P 500 rose 2.35% to 7549.94, the Nasdaq rose 2.74% to 25253.14, and the Dow rose 2.15% to 52389.75. Nvidia fell 4.27%, 第一财经 reported.
December WTI fell 4.38% to 86.85 dollars and January Brent fell 5.85% to 92.57 dollars, 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：12月WTI下跌4.38%至86.85美元，1月布伦特下跌5.85%至92.57美元。

text.en: The 10-year yield rose 1.65 basis points to 4.8738%, and the 2-year yield rose 4.79 basis points to 4.5594%, 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：10年期收益率上涨1.65个基点至4.8738%，2年期上涨4.79个基点至4.5594%。

text.en: COMEX November gold rose 1.00%, or 40.50 dollars, to 4105.00 dollars, 第一财经 reported.
text.zh: 第一财经：COMEX 11月黄金上涨1.00%，即40.50美元，至4105.00美元。

text.en: Shanghai rose 0.32% to 3660.79. October CPI rose 0.7% from a year earlier and PPI rose 5.7%, 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：上证上涨0.32%至3660.79。10月CPI同比上涨0.7%，PPI同比上涨5.7%。

signal.en: US stocks rose and crude prices fell as diplomacy on the Iran war showed progress, while the 2-year Treasury yield still rose. Nvidia fell despite the rise in the indexes, during the spying case. The chart's latest bars are estimates of a slower monthly change in US consumer prices. Mainland producer prices are high because of energy, and stock funds have taken in more than 620 billion yuan over 25 straight sessions.
signal.zh: 美股上涨，原油价格下跌，伊朗战争的外交斡旋有进展，两年期美债收益率仍然上升。英伟达在间谍案期间逆势下跌。图上最近的柱是估计值，显示消费价格的月度变化放缓。内地生产者价格因能源偏高，股票型基金连续25个交易日获得净流入，超过6200亿元。

watch.en: China's October trade figures are due today. US October CPI is at 21:30 Beijing. Waller speaks at 17:00 Beijing, and Logan at 23:50. US October PPI is on 13 November.
watch.zh: 中国10月贸易数字今天公布。美国10月CPI在北京时间21:30。沃勒在北京时间17:00讲话，洛根在23:50。美国10月PPI在11月13日。

text.en: The S&P 500 posted its biggest rise in more than seven months. Nvidia fell despite that rise, after the Huang episode.
text.zh: 标普500指数创下逾七个月来最大涨幅，黄仁勋风波下英伟达逆势下跌

text.en: The Nasdaq Golden Dragon China Index ended a five-session rise. Alibaba and JD were the biggest drags.
text.zh: 金龙中国指数止步五连涨，阿里巴巴和京东对指数拖累最大

text.en: The Treasury curve flattened. Long bonds beat short bonds, and the late drop in oil gave some support.
text.zh: 国债收益率曲线趋平，长债跑赢短债，油价尾盘下跌带来一定支撑

text.en: The dollar index fell as risk appetite rose. The New Zealand dollar led the G10.
text.zh: 随着风险偏好升温，彭博美元指数下跌，新西兰元领涨G10货币

text.en: German government bonds turned down as global equities rebounded and oil fell. European equities rose, with banks and technology strong.
text.zh: 随着全球股市反弹和油价回落，德国国债转跌。欧洲股市上涨，银行和科技板块表现强劲

text.en: Brent touched the lowest since August as diplomacy on the Iran war showed progress.
text.zh: 布伦特原油触及8月份以来最低，与伊朗战争相关的外交斡旋显现进展

text.en: Gold kept rebounding as the oil drop eased the inflation worry. London copper rose.
text.zh: 黄金继续反弹，油价重挫缓解通胀担忧。伦敦期铜走高

source.label: 彭博 Markets Daily China / 财经早茶

title.en: US stocks rose sharply, and Nvidia fell
title.zh: 美股大涨，英伟达逆势下跌

fact.en: The S&P 500 rose 2.35% to 7549.94 and the Nasdaq rose 2.74% to 25253.14, while Nvidia fell 4.27%, 第一财经 reported. CICC said optical modules, semiconductor manufacturing, and grid equipment still need earnings upgrades of 40% to 70% to match the current price, while cloud-company earnings have nearly 20% of room for a downward revision.
fact.zh: 第一财经：标普500上涨2.35%至7549.94，纳斯达克上涨2.74%至25253.14，英伟达下跌4.27%。中金：光模块、半导体制造、电网与配电仍需上修盈利40%至70%，才能匹配当前定价，云厂商盈利有近20%的下修空间。

mechanism.en: US stocks rose, and Nvidia fell 4.27% on the day. CICC (9 November): optical modules, semiconductor manufacturing, and grid equipment still need earnings upgrades of 40% to 70% to match the current price, while cloud-company earnings have nearly 20% of room for a downward revision. The rise is in the broad US indexes, and Nvidia moved the other way.
mechanism.zh: 美股上涨，英伟达当天下跌4.27%。中金（11月9日）：光模块、半导体制造、电网与配电仍需上修盈利40%至70%，才能匹配当前定价，云厂商盈利有近20%的下修空间。上涨在美股大盘，英伟达走势相反。

title.en: Anthropic plans to raise up to 69.3 billion dollars in an IPO
title.zh: Anthropic计划通过IPO最多募集693亿美元

fact.en: Anthropic plans to raise up to 69.3 billion dollars in an IPO, 律动 reported.
fact.zh: 律动：Anthropic计划通过IPO最多募集693亿美元。

mechanism.en: The raise is Anthropic's IPO, and this note names that company. BlockBeats (10 November): Anthropic plans to raise up to 69.3 billion dollars in the IPO. The amount in this day's report is the IPO.
mechanism.zh: 这笔筹资是Anthropic的IPO，这里写的是这家公司。律动（11月10日）：Anthropic计划通过IPO最多募集693亿美元。当天报道里的金额是这次IPO。

title.en: Crude fell to the lowest since August, 财经早茶 said
title.zh: 财经早茶称，原油跌至8月以来最低

fact.en: December WTI fell 4.38% to 86.85 dollars and January Brent fell 5.85% to 92.57 dollars, 华尔街见闻 reported.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：12月WTI下跌4.38%至86.85美元，1月布伦特下跌5.85%至92.57美元。

mechanism.en: Crude fell again, to the lowest 财经早茶 has described since August, as diplomacy on the war showed progress. Saxo (10 November): hopes of a US-Iran deal kept prices falling, and the president's comments added to that pressure. The drop is in the December WTI and January Brent settlements.
mechanism.zh: 原油又跌了一天。财经早茶称这是8月以来最低，与这场战争相关的外交斡旋有进展。盛宝（11月10日）：对美伊达成协议的期望压低了油价，总统的表态加大了下跌压力。跌的是12月WTI和1月布伦特的结算价。

title.en: Gold settled back above the 5 November close
title.zh: 黄金收盘回到11月5日收盘价上方

fact.en: COMEX November gold rose 1.00%, or 40.50 dollars, to 4105.00 dollars, 第一财经 reported. The 5 November settle was 4102.50 dollars and the 6 November settle was 4064.5 dollars.
fact.zh: 第一财经：COMEX 11月黄金上涨1.00%，即40.50美元，至4105.00美元。11月5日收于4102.50美元，11月6日收于4064.5美元。

mechanism.en: Monday's settlement moved back above the 5 November close of 4102.50 dollars after the 6 November drop, so that break did not hold. 财经早茶 (10 November): gold kept rebounding as the oil slide eased the inflation worry. The move is in the COMEX November contract, up 1.00% and 40.50 dollars to 4105.00 dollars.
mechanism.zh: 周一结算价在11月6日下跌之后回到11月5日收盘价4102.50美元上方，那次跌破没有守住。财经早茶（11月10日）：油价下跌缓解了通胀担忧，黄金继续反弹。变动在COMEX 11月黄金合约，上涨1.00%、40.50美元，至4105.00美元。

title.en: Two-year Treasury yields rose more than 10-year yields, and the curve flattened
title.zh: 两年期美债收益率升幅大于十年期，收益率曲线趋平

fact.en: The 10-year yield rose 1.65 basis points to 4.8738%, and the 2-year yield rose 4.79 basis points to 4.5594%, 华尔街见闻 reported.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：10年期收益率上涨1.65个基点至4.8738%，2年期上涨4.79个基点至4.5594%。

mechanism.en: Two-year Treasury yields rose more than 10-year yields, so the curve flattened. Barkin (9 November): rates still need to rise, and any move should stay careful. The move is in those two yields.
mechanism.zh: 两年期美债收益率升幅大于十年期，所以收益率曲线趋平。巴尔金（11月9日）：利率仍需上升，调整步伐应当审慎。变化在这两段收益率上。

title.en: Stock funds kept drawing inflows as Shanghai rose
title.zh: 股票型基金持续获得净流入，上证上涨

fact.en: Shanghai rose 0.32% to 3660.79 and ChiNext fell 0.27% to 2458.56, and stock funds took in more than 620 billion yuan over 25 straight sessions, 华尔街见闻 reported. China's private stock-strategy index fell 11.35% in October, and the quant-long index fell 13.93%, 财新 reported.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：上证上涨0.32%至3660.79，创业板指下跌0.27%至2458.56，股票型基金连续25个交易日净流入超过6200亿元。财新：中国私募股票策略指数10月下跌11.35%，量化多头指数下跌13.93%。

mechanism.en: Private stock strategies fell 11.35% in October, while Shanghai is rising alongside a record streak of fund inflows. 财经早茶 (10 November): the national team added to related funds in the week through 6 November, and that inflow was a record. The inflows show up beside a higher Shanghai close, while the ChiNext index fell. These inflows record subscriptions.
mechanism.zh: 私募股票策略10月下跌11.35%，上证在上涨，基金净流入创下连续纪录。财经早茶（11月10日）：国家队在截至11月6日的一周加码相关基金，这笔流入是纪录。净流入出现在上证收高的同时，创业板指下跌。这些流入记录的是申购。

title.en: Energy led October's rise in producer prices
title.zh: 能源推高了10月生产者价格

fact.en: China's October CPI rose 0.7% from a year earlier and PPI rose 5.7%, the highest since June 2022, 华尔街见闻 reported, citing the statistics bureau.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻引述统计局：中国10月CPI同比上涨0.7%，PPI同比上涨5.7%，为2022年6月以来最高。

mechanism.en: Energy prices pushed producer prices higher, so the gap with consumer prices comes from energy. CICC (9 November): with crude lower after the election, the year-on-year producer pace can ease a little over the next two months, and midstream demand still needs support. This is a 5.7% rise in producer prices against a 0.7% rise in consumer prices.
mechanism.zh: 能源价格推高了生产者价格，所以它和消费价格的差距来自能源。中金（11月9日）：选举之后原油回落，生产者价格同比在接下来两个月或小幅放缓，中下游需求仍需要支持。这份数据是生产者价格同比上涨5.7%，消费价格同比上涨0.7%。

fact.en: London copper rose, 财经早茶 reported.
fact.zh: 财经早茶：伦敦期铜走高。

mechanism.en: London copper rose on the day, and 财经早茶 gave no size for the move. 财经早茶 (10 November): London copper moved higher on the day. The change is in the copper price, and the note gave no separate driver.
mechanism.zh: 伦敦期铜当天上涨，财经早茶没有给出涨幅。财经早茶（11月10日）：伦敦期铜当天走高。变动在铜价，这条记录没有另给原因。

globalRegime.en: US and European stocks rose, and crude prices fell, as diplomacy on the Iran war showed progress. The Treasury yield curve flattened: the 2-year yield rose more than the 10-year yield. Gold rose. Mainland shares were mixed, stock funds extended a long streak of inflows, and energy led the October rise in producer prices. The chart's latest bar for core consumer prices is an estimate, and that estimated monthly rise is smaller than the month before.
globalRegime.zh: 美股和欧洲股市上涨，原油价格下跌，伊朗战争的外交斡旋有进展。美国国债收益率曲线趋平，两年期收益率升幅大于十年期。黄金上涨。内地股市涨跌不一，股票型基金延续一长串净流入，能源带动了10月生产者价格上涨。图上核心消费价格的最新柱是估计值，月度涨幅的估计低于前一个月。

text.en: After meeting Qatar's prime minister, Trump said he believes the Iran war is moving toward an end and that military action is not needed now. Overnight crude futures fell hard on the diplomacy, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：特朗普在与卡塔尔首相会晤后表示，相信伊朗战争正朝结束的方向发展，目前没有必要采取军事行动。外交斡旋进展推动隔夜原油期货重挫。

text.en: Iran said it is under no obligation to accept full nuclear supervision while it faces a US military threat, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：伊朗表示，在面临美国军事打击威胁的情况下，没有义务接受全面的核监督。

text.en: Trump backed Nvidia's chief executive and said the FBI is investigating the China-linked spying case. He does not plan to raise it when he meets Xi, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：特朗普力挺英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋，称联邦调查局正调查涉中国间谍事件，他不打算在与习近平会晤时提出此事。

text.en: Influential lawmakers in both chambers took a closed briefing on Monday from the CIA director and the director of national intelligence on the Huang case, to weigh the national-security risk, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：参众两院有影响力的议员周一闭门听取了中央情报局局长和国家情报总监就黄仁勋事件所做的简报，评估国家安全潜在威胁。

text.en: Anthropic could start its IPO roadshow as soon as Tuesday. It released new Fable and Mythos models, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：Anthropic据悉最快周二启动IPO推介，该公司公布新版Fable和Mythos模型，在上市前巩固AI领域领先地位。

text.en: Google widened its artificial-intelligence chip lineup with two new versions of its tensor processing unit, a further challenge to Nvidia, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：谷歌扩大人工智能芯片产品阵容，推出两个新版本的张量处理单元，进一步挑战英伟达。

text.en: JPMorgan is still positive on US equities and said investor pessimism may be near a peak. A Morgan Stanley strategist said the pullback is near an end and may be setting up a year-end rebound, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：摩根大通依旧看好美股，认为投资者悲观情绪或已接近顶峰。摩根士丹利策略师预计美股回调接近尾声，或正为年末反弹蓄势。

text.en: Defense secretary Hegseth again faces impeachment, and the House could vote as soon as Wednesday. Democrats are also looking at the coming government-funding deadline to press Trump to end the Iran war, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：美国防长海格塞斯再次面临弹劾，众议院最快周三表决相关动议。此外，民主党考虑利用即将到来的政府拨款到期日施压特朗普结束伊朗战争。

text.en: The Richmond Fed president suggested rates need to rise further, but the pace should stay careful. The Chicago Fed president warned of an overheating risk and said inflation has to be faced. US CPI is due Tuesday, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：里士满联储行长暗示利率需要进一步上调，但加息步伐应保持谨慎。芝加哥联储行长警告经济过热风险，称必须应对通胀问题。关注周二将公布的美国CPI数据。

text.en: France blamed Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps for a cyber attack that disabled refrigeration at hundreds of supermarkets, and is seeking retaliation, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：法国将导致国内数百家超市冷藏设备瘫痪的网络攻击归咎于伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队，法方寻求对伊采取报复措施。

text.en: The HFRI fund-weighted composite index fell 1.36% in October, the second-largest monthly drop of 2026, 财新 reported.
text.zh: 财新：HFRI基金等权综合指数10月下跌1.36%，为2026年以来第二大单月跌幅。

text.en: Nvidia's lobbying against export limits has lost influence since the scandal, and related bills may move faster, 律动 reported, citing The Information.
text.zh: 律动引述The Information：丑闻之后，英伟达反对出口限制的游说影响力下降，相关法案可能推进得更快。

text.en: Bitcoin miner MARA sold 13,597 bitcoin in October to repay loans, 律动 reported.
text.zh: 律动：比特币矿商MARA在10月出售13,597枚比特币，用于偿还贷款。

text.en: If the monthly change in consumer prices slows the way the chart's latest bars suggest, the rise in the 2-year Treasury yield has less support. A faster monthly change would extend that rise.
text.zh: 如果消费价格的月度变化像图上最近几根柱那样放缓，两年期美债收益率的上行就少了支撑。月度变化如果更快，这股上行会延续。

text.en: If the Iran talks stall, the drop in crude prices can reverse. A deal that holds keeps the pressure on crude.
text.zh: 如果伊朗谈判停滞，原油价格的下跌可能逆转。协议如果能够维持，原油仍会承压。

text.en: Anthropic plans to raise up to 69.3 billion dollars in an IPO. That plan names Anthropic, apart from Monday's rise in US stocks and from Nvidia's drop.
text.zh: Anthropic计划通过IPO最多募集693亿美元。这是Anthropic的计划，和周一美股上涨、英伟达下跌是分开的。

globalTensions.en: US stocks and gold rose on a day when crude prices fell sharply and the 2-year Treasury yield still rose. Nvidia fell while the Nasdaq rose. Diplomacy is cooling the war premium in crude, and two Fed presidents still say rates need to rise. Private stock strategies had a weak October, and Shanghai rose on Monday.
globalTensions.zh: 美股和黄金上涨的这一天，原油价格大跌，两年期美债收益率仍然上升。纳斯达克上涨，英伟达下跌。外交斡旋在给原油中的战争溢价降温，两位美联储行长仍说利率需要上升。私募股票策略10月表现疲弱，上证周一上涨。

chinaStance.en: Beijing extended the pause on export-control measures against the United States by two months from 10 November. The national team added to funds, and stock funds extended a record inflow streak. China's first yuan sovereign bonds in Canada were nearly 15 times covered. Energy led October producer prices. October trade figures are due today.
chinaStance.zh: 从11月10日起，对美出口管制相关措施再暂停两个月。国家队加码基金，股票型基金把纪录式的净流入延续了下去。中国首次在加拿大发行的人民币主权债获近15倍认购。能源带动了10月生产者价格。10月贸易数据今天公布。

text.en: China reports October trade on Tuesday. The desk expects exports to keep the strongest pace since February, pulled by global demand for AI hardware, and imports to quicken, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：中国周二将公布贸易数据，预计在全球对AI硬件的强劲需求拉动下，出口料保持2月以来最强增长；进口增速有所加快。

text.en: Vice premier He Lifeng discussed extending tariff exemptions, electric vehicles, and more direct flights with Canada's finance minister. The two sides will also deepen financial cooperation. Xinhua said they reached a set of mutually beneficial outcomes, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：中国副总理何立峰与加拿大财长等讨论延长关税豁免、电动车和增加直航问题，此外，中加还将加强金融领域合作。新华社称，两国达成一系列互利共赢成果和共识。

text.en: China's first yuan sovereign bond sale in Canada was nearly 15 times covered, on three-year and five-year notes, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：中国首次在加拿大发行人民币主权债，3年期和5年期据悉获近15倍认购。

text.en: The national team added to its market support in the week through 6 November, and related funds took in a record amount, a Bloomberg compilation showed, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：彭博汇编的数据显示，截至11月6日的一周，中国国家队加码护盘，相关ETF获创纪录资金流入。

text.en: Among US-listed emerging-market funds, flows into mainland China and Hong Kong were the largest last week, and Taiwan saw heavy outflows, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：在美上市新兴市场ETF中，上周流向中国内地和香港的资金规模居首，台湾录得大量流出。

text.en: Chip designer Denglin Technology lists in Hong Kong on Tuesday. The IPO is priced at 231 Hong Kong dollars a share, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：中国芯片研发企业登临科技周二将登陆港交所，IPO定价为每股231港元。

text.en: From 10 November the commerce ministry will keep the pause on export-control and unreliable-entity measures against the United States for another two months, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：中国商务部表示，自11月10日起，继续暂停对美出口管制及不可靠实体清单相关措施两个月。

text.en: Several Chinese and foreign offshore yuan clearing banks completed a first batch of pilot foreign-exchange trades, including yuan against the dollar, the euro, and the Singapore dollar, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：多家中、外资人民币境外清算行近日在银行间外汇市场达成首批试点外汇交易，交易货币对包括人民币对美元、欧元和新加坡元等。

text.en: A US-China-Russia leaders' meeting is uncertain because the two sides differ on the rules and agenda China proposed, the Wall Street Journal reported, 财经早茶 said.
text.zh: 财经早茶：据《华尔街日报》报道，由于美国对中方提议的元首会晤规则和议程存在分歧，中美俄三方元首峰会能否举办存在不确定性。

text.en: Taiwan's October exports rose sharply, and the monthly total passed 90 billion dollars for the first time, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：台湾10月出口同比大增，单月金额首度突破900亿美元。

text.en: October CPI rose 0.7% from a year earlier and PPI rose 5.7%, the highest producer pace since June 2022, 华尔街见闻 reported, citing the statistics bureau. Energy-related industries did the lifting.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻引述统计局：10月CPI同比上涨0.7%，PPI同比上涨5.7%，为2022年6月以来最高的生产者价格。能源相关行业是上拉的主力。

text.en: Stock funds have taken in more than 620 billion yuan over 25 straight sessions since 28 September, a record streak, 华尔街见闻 reported, citing Shanghai Securities News.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻引述上证报：9月28日以来，股票型基金连续25个交易日净流入，合计超过6200亿元，创下最长连续净流入纪录。

text.en: If today's trade figures are as strong as 财经早茶 expects, exports are still supporting growth. A sharp miss would leave more of that weight on the fund inflows.
text.zh: 如果今天的贸易数据和财经早茶预期的一样强，出口仍在支撑增长。如果明显低于预期，更多分量会落在基金净流入上。

text.en: If energy stops leading producer prices, the gap with the 0.7% rise in consumer prices narrows from the energy side.
text.zh: 如果能源不再带动生产者价格，它和消费价格同比上涨0.7%之间的差距会从能源这一侧收窄。

chinaDivergences.en: Shanghai rose while the ChiNext index fell. Producer prices are high because of energy, while consumer prices are rising slowly. Private stock strategies fell sharply in October, and Shanghai rose on Monday with a record streak of fund inflows. Nvidia fell while the Nasdaq rose.
chinaDivergences.zh: 上证上涨，创业板指下跌。生产者价格因能源偏高，消费价格涨得慢。私募股票策略10月跌幅很大，上证周一上涨，基金净流入创下连续纪录。纳斯达克上涨，英伟达下跌。

note.en: Dates run from this briefing, 10 November, through next Friday, 20 November. Rows marked China are mainland China only. No Federal Reserve policy meeting falls in these dates. After the November switch to standard time, a policy decision at 14:00 US Eastern would be 03:00 Beijing the next day.
note.zh: 日期从本期简报的11月10日到下周五11月20日。标为中国的，只包括中国内地。这段时间没有美联储议息会议。11月已经切换到标准时间，如果美联储在美东时间14:00做决定，就是次日北京时间03:00。

event.zh: 古巴党和政府特使罗德里格斯访华，至11月13日

sources.en: The mail copy is the 10 November 财经早茶. Monday equity, yield, oil, and mainland closes, plus October CPI and PPI, are 华尔街见闻. COMEX gold, the Dow, and Nvidia's move are 第一财经. 财新 covers October hedge-fund and private-fund returns. 律动 covers the Anthropic IPO size, Barkin, the MARA coin sale, and the Nvidia lobbying note. CICC's 9 November notes sit on US equities and on the producer-price gap. The 5 November and 6 November gold settles are the 6 November and 9 November 华尔街见闻 breakfasts. The chart figures are approximate readings from the image.
sources.zh: 邮件底稿是11月10日财经早茶。周一的股票、收益率、原油和内地收盘，以及10月CPI和PPI，来自华尔街见闻。COMEX黄金、道指和英伟达的涨跌来自第一财经。财新覆盖10月对冲基金和私募基金回报。律动覆盖Anthropic的IPO规模、巴尔金、MARA售币和英伟达游说。中金11月9日的笔记写在美股和生产者价格缺口上。11月5日和11月6日的黄金收盘来自11月6日和11月9日华尔街见闻早餐。图上的数字是从图上读出的约数。

caveats: Event Calendar mainland China only on China rows. Equity, yield, oil, and bitcoin rows in Market closes are the inject snapshot. The chart heights are approximate readings of the image. Desk lines name the desk.

note.en: Equities, FX, gold futures, and Brent futures use the latest Yahoo daily bar; a session still open at the snapshot is intraday, not a close (Brent row is Yahoo BZ=F — not the same print as the CNBC settle); US Treasuries use the official daily yield curve (bp vs prior print); BTC is CoinGecko 24h change; funding compares adjacent OKX prints. Snapshot captured at generate time — not live on the page.
note.zh: 股票、外汇、黄金期货和布伦特期货采用 Yahoo 最近日线柱；快照时尚未收盘的时段是盘中，不是收盘（布伦特一行是 Yahoo BZ=F，与 CNBC 结算价不是同一报价）；美国国债采用官方日度收益率曲线（相对前值的基点）；比特币为 CoinGecko 的 24 小时变动；资金费率比较相邻的 OKX 报价。快照取自生成时点，不是本页实时行情。
